item.title: Canada overcomes cheating allegations to win Olympic gold in men’s curling at Milan Cortina Games
item.description: CORTINA D'AMPEZZO, Italy (AP) — The Canadian men brushed aside earlier accusations of cheating and beat Britain for Olympic gold in curling on Saturday at the Milan Cortina Games. Brad Jacobs’ team defeated Bruce Mouat’s all-Scottish squad 9-6 inside Cortina’s historic ice arena to give curling powerhouse Canada it’s only gold of the Olympics in the sport. item.title: 3-year-old hit, killed in parking lot collision
item.description: The Hawai‘i Island police are investigating a single-vehicle collision inside a residential complex parking lot that claimed the life of a three-year-old girl.

item.title: Smoky smell inside high-rise prompts HFD response
item.description: A smoky smell inside a high-rise building in Ala Moana prompted a six-unit response by the Honolulu Fire Department.

item.title: Evacuation lifted for ʻŌtake Camp in Waialua, CORE responds to a dozen homeless individuals
item.description: The City and County of Honolulu has issued an evacuation order for the residents of ʻŌtake Camp in the Waialua area due to rising water levels and dangerous flooding conditions.

item.title: Honolulu wastewater overflow spills into Ahuimanu Stream
item.description: Heavy rainfall overwhelmed the Ahuimanu Preliminary Treatment Facility causing a wastewater overflow that reached a nearby stream and prompted environmental testing.

item.title: Honolulu Fire Department investigates accidental Kalihi blaze
item.description: The Honolulu Fire Department has determined that a residential fire in Kalihi earlier this week was accidental, officials said.

item.title: Heavy rains, flooding slam Oahu and Kauai
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Flash Flood Warning for Kauai and Oahu until Saturday afternoon.
